sections.shortTitle: Balochistan Prohibition On Use and Sale of Polythene Bags Ordinance 2001
sections.description:
Short title, extent and commencement

ORDINANCE V OF 2001
BALOCHISTAN
PROHIBITION ON USE AND SALE OF POLYTHENE BAGS ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE V OF 2001
An Ordinance to
prohibit the sale and use of polythene bags in the Province of Balochistan
[Gazette of
Balochistan Extraordinary, 17th March, 2001]
No. Legis: 1-117/Law/2000,
dated 17-3-2001.--The following Ordinance made by the Governor of
Balochistan on 19th February, 2001, is hereby published for general
information.
1. Short title, extent and
commencement.---(1) This Ordinance may be called the Balochistan
Prohibition on Use and Sale of Polythene Bags Ordinance, 2001.
(2) It extends to the whole of
Province of Balochistan except Tribal Areas.
(3) It shall come into force at
once.

2. Definitions.--In this
Ordinance unless the context otherwise requires the following expressions shall
have the meaning hereby respectively assigned to them, that is to say-
(a)"Factory"
means any premises where the polythene bags are made and produced;
(b)
"Person" includes a shopkeepers, factory owners, hawkers and others.
(c)
"Polythene bags" means a leading thermoplastic processed from
polythene granules.

shall import, make, sale and offer any kind of eatable and non-eatable goods in
any kind of polythene bags in the Province of Balochistan.
